text.en: Believing every photon in a Raman experiment is Raman-scattered, rather than the overwhelming majority scattering elastically (Rayleigh scattering, unshifted) and only a tiny fraction exchanging energy with a vibrational mode — this is why Raman spectroscopy needs sensitive detectors and a strong, well-filtered source.
text.et: Uskumine, et Raman-katses hajub iga footon Raman-hajumisel, mitte see, et enamik hajub elastselt (Rayleighi hajumine, nihketa) ja ainult väike osa vahetab energiat võnkemoodiga — just seetõttu vajab Raman-spektroskoopia tundlikke detektoreid ja tugevat, hästi filtreeritud valgusallikat.
